integrity: Original analytical claim is supported by a dimension-uniform proof and finite exact-rational consistency checks; historical priority is subject to independently examining additional sources.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to the uniform full-dimensional interior distribution of even- or odd-parity demihypercubes in dimensions at least three; it does not address arbitrary parity restrictions or vertex-uniform distributions. Historical priority is provisional. Numerical hull tests in four finite dimensions supplement, but do not replace, the general proof.
title: The five-dimensional minimum of the demihypercube isotropic constant
